summary: Partial, source-backed link checkpoint. AdicSpaces supplies Huber and rational-localization interfaces to Part II and perfectoid foundations; its adic carrier and gluing support generalized analytic presentations, relative period geometry, character spaces and Coleman neighborhoods. Its canonical Spa is the comparison target for Berkovich geometry. Layer 6 supplies the actual fixed-field Q_p curve to FarguesFontaineDiamonds and the ring-level specialization of relative annuli. No incoming cross-roadmap prerequisite is established by this checkpoint. Rescope Part II's repeated elementary immersions to reuse Layer 5; resolve the FF_ADIC/ADIC placeholder dependencies to precise canonical prefixes. General tensor-product sheafiness, perfectoid almost cohomology, relative noetherianness and p-adic Hodge comparison are not inferred from the foundations. Detailed partner review is complete for the listed sources, but the exhaustive catalogue-wide keyword/synonym and every-upstream-stage pass remains unfinished. This is not ready for integration or a claim of job completion.
